cards.name: Flare of Denial
cards.oracleText:
You may sacrifice a nontoken blue creature rather than pay this spell's mana cost.
Counter target spell.

cards.name: Flare of Fortitude
cards.oracleText:
You may sacrifice a nontoken white creature rather than pay this spell's mana cost.
Until end of turn, your life total can't change, and permanents you control gain hexproof and indestructible.

cards.name: Flare of Duplication
cards.oracleText:
You may sacrifice a nontoken red creature rather than pay this spell's mana cost.
Copy target instant or sorcery spell. You may choose new targets for the copy.

cards.name: Flare of Cultivation
cards.oracleText:
You may sacrifice a nontoken green creature rather than pay this spell's mana cost.
Search your library for up to two basic land cards, reveal those cards, put one onto the battlefield tapped and the other into your hand, then shuffle.

cards.name: Flare of Faith
cards.oracleText: Target creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn. If it's a Human, instead it gets +3/+3 and gains indestructible until end of turn.

cards.name: Flare of Malice
cards.oracleText:
You may sacrifice a nontoken black creature rather than pay this spell's mana cost.
Each opponent sacrifices a creature or planeswalker with the greatest mana value among creatures and planeswalkers they control.

cards.name: Flare
cards.oracleText:
Flare deals 1 damage to any target.
Draw a card at the beginning of the next turn's upkeep.

cards.name: Flaring Pain
cards.oracleText:
Damage can't be prevented this turn.
Flashback {R} (You may cast this card from your graveyard for its flashback cost. Then exile it.)

cards.name: Flaring Flame-Kin
cards.oracleText: As long as this creature is enchanted, it gets +2/+2, has trample, and has "{R}: This creature gets +1/+0 until end of turn."

cards.name: Flaring Cinder
cards.oracleText: When this creature enters and whenever you cast a spell with mana value 4 or greater, you may discard a card. If you do, draw a card.
